scope: SYCL single-device static expert cache, existing owned or borrowed Prefill layout
default: exact getenv value 1 only; original CUDA/HIP/default release remains
success_order: all prompt segments and synchronous callbacks return
checked owned frees with per-success nulling
cancel_order: checked global drain before refill may overwrite loaned scratch
recreation: init maximum configured chunk and original maximum loan
no_batch_request: no lend, no recreate after prior retirement
keep_owners: target and draft KV/page tables/full physical 256K host backing
retire_owners: old Impl host vectors/Gemm external bindings/mmq context
failure: any unknown drain/free/exception immediately _Exit, no destructor retry, caller queue destruction or continuation; already successful frees remain null and remaining registry owners stay reachable
